# Vendored HTMX

`htmx.min.js` is the unmodified HTMX 2.0.10 distribution asset fetched from the official
`bigskysoftware/htmx` release tag. It is vendored so ReleaseProof does not require Node or a
runtime CDN. The SHA-256 checksum is recorded after download and verified by the M1 tests.

- Version: `2.0.10`
- Source: `https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/releases/tag/v2.0.10`
- SHA-256: `71ea67185bfa8c98c39d31717c6fce5d852370fcdfd129db4543774d3145c0de`
